modules.module_title: Work organization and management (Mechatronics) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Maintain a safe, clean, and well-organized work area following workplace design principles.
Prepare self for tasks by adhering to all relevant health, safety, and environmental guidelines.
Schedule work activities efficiently to maximize productivity and minimize disruptions.
Select, handle, and operate equipment and materials safely as per manufacturer instructions.
Apply workplace health, safety, and environmental standards consistently during all activities.
Restore the work area to an acceptable condition after completing tasks.
Collaborate effectively with team members to achieve group objectives.
Exchange constructive feedback and offer support to colleagues to enhance team performance.
Work efficiently to minimize wastage of materials, time, and energy.

KU2. Understanding of effective communication methods in oral, written, and digital forms.

gs: GS1. Ability to read, interpret, and extract relevant technical information accurately.

GS3. Skill in communicating clearly and effectively across different mediums.

modules.module_title: Communication and interpersonal skills (Mechatronics) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Read, interpret, and extract technical information from documentation in paper or electronic formats.
Communicate clearly and effectively using oral, written, and electronic methods.
Use standard communication technologies and tools for professional interactions.
Explain and discuss complex technical concepts, principles, and applications with colleagues and stakeholders.
Prepare and complete routine and exception reports accurately as per organizational standards.
Respond to client needs promptly and professionally, both in person and through indirect communication.
Collect relevant information and prepare required documentation according to client or organizational requirements.

kus: KU1. Knowledge of system design principles for industrial and mechatronic applications.
KU2. Understanding of identifying and resolving ambiguities in technical specifications.
KU3. Knowledge of design optimization within operational and technical constraints.
gs: GS1. Ability to design systems based on industrial application requirements.
GS2. Skill in identifying and resolving specification gaps effectively.
GS3. Ability to optimize designs within given constraints.

modules.module_title: Developing mechatronics systems (Mechatronics) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Carry out system design for given industrial applications, considering functional and technical requirements.
Identify and resolve areas of uncertainty within briefs or specifications.
Optimize designs within the parameters of the specifications and operational constraints.
Assemble machines according to digital documentation, including written instructions and 2D/3D designs.
Connect wires, tubing, and fluid lines according to industry standards.
Incorporate robots and handling systems within mechatronic systems as required.
Integrate HMI devices and interfaces into the system for effective operation.
Incorporate safety devices such as emergency stops, safety sensors, and relays into the system.
Install, set up, and adjust mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, and sensor systems to ensure full functionality.
Configure and parameterize complex sensors, including vision systems, color sensors, and incremental systems, following standard manuals.
Commission machines using auxiliary equipment and PLCs, adhering to standard procedures and documentation.

kus: KU1. Knowledge of PLC integration and its role in mechatronic system automation.
KU2. Understanding of industrial networks and communication protocols such as OPC-UA.
KU3. Knowledge of configuration and operation of industrial controllers.
gs: GS1. Ability to integrate and connect PLCs with mechatronic systems.

modules.module_title: Using industrial controllers (Mechatronics) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Integrate and connect PLCs to mechatronic systems for control and automation.
Set up industrial networks/bus systems to enable communication between PLCs, HMI devices, other electronics, distributed devices, and PCs via OPC-UA.
Configure industrial controllers to meet operational requirements.
Set up and configure all aspects of PLCs, including associated control circuitry, for correct system operation.
Establish and verify proper communications between and among controllers and peripheral devices.

kus: KU1. • Knowledge of PLC integration and its role in mechatronic system automation.
gs: GS1. • Ability to integrate and connect PLCs with mechatronic systems.

pcs.pc_description: Write software programs to control mechatronic systems, ensuring correct functionality.
Visualize and simulate processes and operations using industrial software tools.
Program PLCs, including handling digital and analog signals and integrating industrial field buses.
Develop and configure HMI devices to provide interactive control and monitoring.
Implement reliable and correct communication (“handshakes”) between PLCs and other system components.

kus: KU1. • Knowledge of principles, applications, and standards for circuit schematics.
gs: GS1. • Ability to apply schematic principles and standards in circuit design.

pcs.pc_description: Understand and apply principles, applications, and standards for circuit schematics.
Read and interpret pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical circuit schematics accurately.
Design electrical circuits for mechatronic systems using standard principles and practices.
Assemble and implement designed circuits in mechatronic systems following industry standards.
Use modern software tools to design, simulate, and validate circuit schematics.

kus: KU1. • Knowledge of testing procedures for modules and complete mechatronic systems.
gs: GS1. • Ability to conduct test runs of modules and complete systems effectively.

modules.module_title: Analysing, commissioning, and maintenance (Mechatronics) — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Conduct test runs of individual modules and fully assembled mechatronic systems.
Review each part of the process and system against established performance criteria.
Identify faults in mechatronic systems using appropriate analytical and problem-solving techniques.
Collect and represent operational data using diagrams, bar graphs, and digital formats.
Perform repairs on components efficiently and effectively.
Optimize the operation of individual modules using analysis and problem-solving methods.
Optimize the operation of the entire mechatronic system for performance and efficiency.
Apply principles and techniques to generate creative and innovative solutions for system issues.
Present assembled systems to clients and respond to queries professionally.
Measure and monitor consumed energy using sensors and appropriate measuring devices.
